sections.text_helper: Section 30.4.7 "Modular inversion" in chapter 30 (Public key accelerator (PKA)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 933.
sections.section_content:
The modular inversion operation calculates multiplicative inverse A-1modn. If the modulus
n is prime, for all values of A (1≤A<n) modular inversion output is valid. If the modulus n is
not prime, A has an inverse only if the greatest common divisor between A and n is 1.
If the operand A is a divisor of the modulus n the result is a multiple of a factor of n.
